name: FivetranVerbose_CL

schema.name: FivetranVerbose_CL
schema.description: High volume, low severity Fivetran connector logs (any level other than WARNING or SEVERE) on the Auxiliary table plan. Retained for investigation and forensics at minimal ingestion cost. Alerts cannot run against an Auxiliary table; use a summary rule as described in VOLUME-AND-COST.md.

columns.name: TimeGenerated
columns.description: Ingestion timestamp, derived from CreatedAt in the DCR transform. Auxiliary tables require TimeGenerated in ISO 8601 format with six decimal places of precision.

columns.name: Level
columns.description: Log level reported by Fivetran. Expected to be INFO for this table.

columns.name: CreatedAt
columns.description: Timestamp of the log event as sent by Fivetran.
